entries.title: Your whole conversation on your iPhone and iPad
entries.body: Above the message box on your iPhone and iPad, a card you chose on or replied under now shows as its own round, and its title opens the card. Press a message to open the conversation: your messages, your first mate's whole replies and the cards you acted on, by day. Its Cards view lists the cards waiting on you, then the ones you answered. A press on a card opens it, and putting the card away brings the conversation back.

picture.alt: The conversation on an iPad, with the captain's messages on the right, the first mate's replies on the left and a card's tile before the choice made on it
